gaps.explanation: Statement total 174,423 = proprietary statement p6 Total: charges for services 157,324 + miscellaneous 400 + interest income 1,249 + insurance proceeds 15,450. detail[] has the Water/Sewer/Sanitation funds only as expenditure lines from the combined all-funds budget schedule (p9), which prints revenues for all funds combined only, so no business-type revenue line is in detail. Add the revenue rows of the Water, Sewer and Sanitation columns of p6: Water 77,436 + 497; Sewer 30,397 + 487; Sanitation 49,491 + 400 + 265 + 15,450. Check: 0 + 77,933 + 30,884 + 65,606 = 174,423 = statement total.
